info.title: DocCheck API
info.description: Create shipments, upload their freight documents (commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or air waybill, ISF, certificates of origin and the other supported types), validate them against the requirements of Canada, the US, Mexico, the EU or the UK and read the findings. Authenticate with an API key from Integrations → API keys: `Authorization: Bearer dck_...`. Keys have the read and/or write scope and a limit of requests per minute (RateLimit-* headers). Events (document.extracted, validation.completed, finding.created, finding.resolved, supplier.replied) are pushed to webhooks signed with HMAC-SHA256 (DocCheck-Signature header).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: open: not validated yet or extracting; attention: validated with open findings; done: validated with none.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text in the reference or id.

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key

post.description: Scope: write. Send the destination now or later in the app; validation needs it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any string up to 255 characters, new per operation. A retry with the same key gets the first answer (Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of doing the work twice. Kept 24 hours.

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key

409.description: Not possible in the current state

get.summary: Get a shipment with its documents and status
get.description: Scope: read. status: RECEIVED → EXTRACTING → VALIDATING → DONE (or NEEDS_INPUT when a rule lacks a document).

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key

post.description: Scope: write. Up to 10 files of 20 MB each in the multipart field "files": PDFs (a combined PDF is split into its documents), spreadsheets (.xlsx, .csv) or photos (JPEG, PNG, HEIC; straightened into a PDF). Each is classified and extracted by the local model; document.extracted follows for each. Every file counts as an extraction of the organization's plan: past a hard limit the upload is refused with 402.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any string up to 255 characters, new per operation. A retry with the same key gets the first answer (Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of doing the work twice. Kept 24 hours.

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key

402.description: The organization’s plan limit is reached

409.description: Not possible in the current state

get.summary: Get a document and its extracted data
get.description: Scope: read. `data` holds the normalized values (decimal strings, ISO dates, kilograms) once the document is EXTRACTED.

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key

post.description: Scope: write. Runs the deterministic rules on the extracted documents, cites regulations and lets the local model review ambiguous cases. Answers 202 at once (validation.completed follows), or 200 with the validation when wait=true.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: false skips the local model review of ambiguous cases. Default: the server setting.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: true answers when the validation is done (200, with the findings); otherwise 202 at once and validation.completed follows.

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key

402.description: The organization’s plan limit is reached

409.description: Not possible in the current state

get.description: Scope: read. Each finding cites its evidence (document, JSON pointer, page and line) and, where one exists, the regulation passage. 404 before the first validation.

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key

get.description: Scope: read. CargoWise Universal Shipment XML or ANSI X12 004010 (856 ship notice, 310 ocean freight receipt), built from the documents the latest validation read; an air shipment exports from its air waybill (the 310, an ocean bill of lading, is refused for it). 409 before validation or when a document the format needs is missing.

409.description: Not possible in the current state

post.summary: Send an export through a connector
post.description: Scope: write. Only the "mock" connector ships with DocCheck; live connectors (CargoWise eAdapter, a VAN) need partner credentials.

apiKey.description: An API key from Integrations → API keys.

reference.description: Your reference: a file number, PO or booking.

destination.description: CA (CBSA), US (CBP), MX (SAT/ANAM), EU (Union Customs Code) or GB (HMRC). Needed before validating.

format.description: How it was uploaded when not a PDF: a spreadsheet, or a photo (made into a PDF).

findingCount.description: Open findings of the latest validation; null if never validated.

documents.description: Queued for extraction; document.extracted follows for each.

data.description: Normalized values, as the validation reads them. Absent until extracted.

corrected.description: Values corrected by hand in the app, with what the model had read.

fingerprint.description: Stable across validations while the rule and values stay the same.

review.description: The user's latest decision about it.

skipped.description: Rules that could not run, and the documents they lack.

resolved.description: Findings of the previous validation that are gone.
